questions.promptEn:
다음 영어풀이에 해당하는 단어가 들어간 문장은?
being entirely without fault or defect
① The weather changed quickly.
② Reaching this goal will take time.
③ This is the perfect place to study.
④ There is a small dot on the screen.
⑤ She carefully put the glass on the table.
choices: Reaching this goal will take time.
This is the perfect place to study.

questions.promptEn:
다음 밑줄 친 단어의 의미가 나머지와 다른 것은?
① Our class <u>held</u> a talent show.
② The school <u>held</u> a festival last week.
③ He <u>held</u> the camera to take a picture.
④ The museum <u>held</u> a special exhibition.
⑤ The city <u>held</u> a marathon last Saturday.
choices: Our class held a talent show.
The school held a festival last week.
He held the camera to take a picture.
The museum held a special exhibition.
The city held a marathon last Saturday.

questions.promptEn:
다음 빈칸 ⓐ~ⓒ에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
• I'm ⓐ______ remembering names.
• He looks forward ⓑ______ his friends.
• She folded a ⓒ______ of paper into a small square.
① sure that / to see / goal
② sure that / to see / mark
③ good at / at seeing / mark
④ good at / to seeing / sheet
⑤ looking up at / to seeing / sheet
choices: looking up at / to seeing / sheet

questions.promptEn:
다음 단어의 영어풀이가 바르지 않은 것은?
① allow: to let someone do something
② return: to give back or go back to a place
③ practice: to do many times in order to become skilled
④ unique: having no equal; different from everything else
⑤ borrow: to try something new in order to learn or gain experience
choices: allow: to let someone do something
return: to give back or go back to a place
practice: to do many times in order to become skilled
unique: having no equal; different from everything else
borrow: to try something new in order to learn or gain experience

bet: to feel ______ about something without knowing it as a fact
→ ______

questions.promptEn:
다음 중 빈칸에 적절한 말의 형태가 나머지와 다른 것은? (대·소문자 구분 없음)
① These results may ______ you.
② Don't ______ me like that again.
③ The gift was an unexpected ______.
④ She planned a ______ for his birthday.
⑤ He looked ______ when he heard the news.
choices: She planned a ______ for his birthday.
He looked ______ when he heard the news.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ① — 'New York is big and has a few people'는 '사람이 적다'라는 뜻이 되어 어색하다. many people이 되어야 한다. (답지 P147 p.13 14)
questions.promptEn:
다음 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?
① New York is big and has <u>a few</u> people.
② He posted the results <u>on the board</u>.
③ She handed her friend <u>a bottle of water</u>.
④ He keeps a diary to <u>record</u> his thoughts.
⑤ He thought <u>for a moment</u> before answering.
choices: New York is big and has a few people.
He posted the results on the board.
She handed her friend a bottle of water.
He keeps a diary to record his thoughts.
He thought for a moment before answering.

questions.explainKo: 정답: (1) sign (2) giving (3) snowstorm — (답지 P147 p.13 15)
questions.promptEn:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 <보기>에서 적절한 단어를 골라 빈칸에 쓰시오. (필요시 어형을 바꿀 것)
<보기> snowstorm　give　sign　later　support
(1) 당신은 마감일 전에 등록해야만 합니다.
→ You must ______ up before the deadline.
(2) 그는 발표를 하는 것에 대해 긴장하고 있다.
→ He is nervous about ______ a presentation.
(3) 우리는 눈보라 때문에 여행을 취소했다.
→ We canceled the trip because of the ______.

introKo: 통과 80%. Vocabulary 심화는 어휘 관계, 문장 완성, 영작입니다. 고르기는 보기 하나를 누르고, 빈칸은 답만 쓰세요.
